manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Rootha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Repeat from step 4.
